items.title: an `[rpc]` signature written with a MODULE PATH — `std::hash_map::HashMap<str, i32>` — is refused as "not Wire"
items.body: A144 made the contract hash read the resolved type; the Wire check still reads the spelling. Repro: change the return type in the `a144_an_alias_and_its_target_hash_alike` pin program. Rec: run the Wire check on the resolved type. Sizing S.
